static_traits.name: Chen Mandi
static_traits.family_status: Raised by stepfather, information about biological father missing, never met
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty building close relationships with classmates due to fear of judgment; has one good friend but has not yet shared feelings of inferiority
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no previous psychotherapy or psychiatric visits
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, willing to cooperate; the rest Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I have always firmly believed I inherited 'lack of intelligence' from my biological father whom I never met, which gives me strong feelings of inferiority and fear of failing in college.
basic_info.core_demands: I came to counseling because these feelings of inferiority have begun to affect my academic performance and my overall physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: Original and family experience: raised by stepfather from childhood, with no contact or information source regarding biological father. The idea of 'inadequate intelligence inherited from biological father' gradually formed, becoming an important basis for self-evaluation.

From adolescence to now: worries about one's own inadequate ability began in puberty, significantly worsening in college when facing exams and difficult programming tasks; simultaneously feeling society's expectations and pressure for academic excellence, reinforcing Fear of failure and inferiority.

core_beliefs: I am not smart enough (this is innately determined)
I am destined to fail at university

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not test well, it proves I am innately not smart, and will surely fail in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-preparation, constantly Self-doubting and seeking others' affirmation, even at the cost of sleep
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time will surely be failed, I am not suited for this major

special_situations.event: When stuck facing difficult programming assignments or projects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot solve a problem for the moment, it shows I am really stupid, never capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling study efforts to try to prove oneself, grinding at tasks for long periods
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot handle this problem, showing I am not smart enough

special_situations.event: After receiving positive feedback from the professor or passing a course
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only effortlessly achieving perfect results counts as ability; other successes do not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing achievements to luck, continuing to negate one's own ability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This time was just luck, not representing that I am truly capable

special_situations.event: When in contact with classmates and needing to cooperate or build closer relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they discover I am not smart enough, they will look down on me and stay away
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding building intimate relationships, reducing opportunities to expose one's inadequate ability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am dumb and will judge me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, recognized, and supported by father-like authority and significant others, confirming that she is capable and worthy of being loved
core_conflict.fear: Fearing exposure of inadequacy leading to judgment or being rejected, fearing disappointing important others and confirming 'oneself innately incapable'
defense_goal: Maintains a cautious relational distance to avoid being judged
Attributing success to luck, inadequate ability to genetics, to reduce guilt and Anxiety
Controlling uncertainty through Over-preparation and seeking external recognition

object_relations.self_representation: A Student not smart enough, possibly failing at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Others (classmates, teachers, authorities) are harsh judgers

object_relations.self_representation: A child abandoned by an absent father, carrying 'problem genes'
object_relations.object_representation: Biological father as a distant and negative source (the root of inadequate ability)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes success evidence such as passing courses and professors' positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the other party may be ignoring real difficulties or just comforting her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and reserved tone, explaining success as luck or chance, downplaying the role of one's own ability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about biological father and the topic of 'genetically inadequate intelligence'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Abstracting current inferiority and Anxiety into genetic and innate factors, avoiding touching feelings of being abandoned and sadness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use objective, scientific terms to discuss genetics and intelligence, keep emotions flat, express personal feelings less.

manifestations: Views ability and future as predetermined by genes, experiencing a lack of control over life
In exam and challenge situations, self-limits, believing effort can hardly change the result
outcomes: Growing reliance on external evaluation and recognition

manifestations: Never establishing a relationship with biological father, experiencing an absent parent-child connection
Due to fear of being judged, hard to build close relationships with classmates
outcomes: Social avoidance and Sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-doubt and self-reproach, worrying about disappointing important others (such as stepfather, teachers)
Focusing more on one's own inadequacies in counseling, cautiously expressing positive aspects

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Presupposing classmates will look down on oneself, making negative evaluations of one's ability
Assuming others hold negating attitudes even before interpersonal contact

positive_force: All previous courses have been passed and positive feedback obtained from professors, showing learning ability and a level of engagement
Willing to try new strategies (task breakdown, recording observations), and maintaining an Active help-seeking attitude
Has a friend to confide in (potential support resource)
Has a stable caregiver (raised by stepfather)
Able to identify and describe one's own negative Automatic thoughts, possessing some self-awareness
negative_force: Strong genetic-determinism beliefs, tending to attribute ability to innate unchangeable factors
Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Overly relying on external recognition, tending to negate positive evidence
Marked Anxiety before exams and under high-pressure tasks, affecting sleep and focus
Avoids building intimate relationships out of fear of being judged, reducing social support

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and catastrophic Self-deprecation before exams and when facing difficult programming assignments
antecedent: Facing complex or stuck programming tasks
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief of 'oneself innately not smart, destined to fail' combined with social achievement pressure, leading to catastrophic Anticipation of failure
target_behavior.function: Temporarily reducing uncertainty and Anxiety through Over-preparation and seeking comfort, avoiding facing the Fear of being proven a failure
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased attention, Sleep disturbance, impaired academic efficiency, further Reinforcing Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids forming close relationships with classmates, reducing cooperation and deep communication
antecedent: Needs to cooperate with classmates or have closer interactions
Anticipating being judged by others as having inadequate ability
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing the emotions of being negated and shame; reinforcing avoidance through mind-reading-style presupposition that 'others look down on me'
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluations and shame experiences, reducing Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Social isolation, Weak support system, further worsening inferiority and Academic pressure
